task: Exhaustive search for a government OPEN DATASET covering North Sydney LGA parking (meters, time limits, permit zones, rates)
conclusion: NO government open dataset publishes North Sydney LGA parking meters, time limits, permit zones, or rates. North Sydney Council does not publish parking data on any open-data portal (data.nsw, data.gov.au, TfNSW Open Data Hub) nor as an ArcGIS Online/Hub feature service. The only machine-readable North Sydney parking sources are the council's own custom Google My Maps + a council PDF (already captured in ../northsydney-meters.json and ../northsydney-permit-areas.json), which are NOT formal open datasets.

data.nsw.gov.au (CKAN).result: No North Sydney parking dataset. Parking datasets are City of Sydney (meters, permit areas, ticket rates) + TfNSW hub items. resource_search returned 43 parking resources, none for North Sydney.

per_council_kerbside_signs_datasets: Willoughby Street Parking Signs (Chatswood CBD only)
opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au (TfNSW Ope.statewide_signs_dataset: NONE - no NSW-wide 'parking signs'/'kerbside' layer exists; signs data is per-council and only Willoughby & Waverley opted in.
opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au (TfNSW Ope.result: No North Sydney dataset among the 46 parking datasets.

data.gov.au (federal CKAN).result: Mirrors data.nsw + other councils (City of Sydney, Ballarat, Brisbane, Hobart, Ipswich, Melbourne, Geelong, Port Phillip). North Sydney Council publishes flood data only. No North Sydney parking.

ArcGIS Hub + ArcGIS Online.result: No North Sydney Council parking feature service. All authoritative parking services are City of Sydney (owner cityofsydneyspatial). Only NS-parking hit was a consultant web map 'P2945 North Sydney Traffic and Parking Study LATM Assessment' (owner: Bitzios, a traffic consultancy) - a study, not an authoritative rules dataset, not downloadable as structured parking layers.

adjacent_lga_datasets_found_not_north_sy.name: City of Sydney parking (meters/permit areas/ticket rates)
adjacent_lga_datasets_found_not_north_sy.note: has structured maxstay/fee/permit fields but only City of Sydney LGA

flags_for_north_sydney_open_data.explanation: All false: no OPEN dataset carries these for the North Sydney LGA. (Meter locations + demand tiers and permit-area polygons exist for North Sydney only via the council's own Google My Maps/PDF, already recovered separately - not an open dataset.)
